# Phase 5C preparation — Vancouver

Prepared 2026-10-13T21:54:31.358Z. Preparation only: v2 draft; every human check and decision remains pending. No reviewer/acknowledgement/receipt created.

Historical evidence remains unchanged in [phase3f-place-Q24639.md](phase3f-place-Q24639.md); the following research was performed in Phase 5C only. The action ledger is [phase5c-batch1-research-actions.json](../../../content/operations/phase5c-batch1-research-actions.json).

Four places remain: Stanley Park, Granville Island Public Market, Gastown, Queen Elizabeth Park. No Capilano, Whistler, North Shore attraction or Vancouver Island trip added.

Claim correspondence:
- City of Vancouver directly supports Stanley Park's urban forest, trails, beaches and seawall. No wildlife or accessibility guarantee.
- Granville Island operator market/access URLs failed in both source reader and one bounded direct fetch each. Do not call those successful rechecks. Replaced current citations with directly inspected Destination Vancouver market/neighbourhood material; it supports indoor food/produce and craft vendors. Operator URLs remain in historical research and the failure ledger.
- Municipal heritage regulation page directly supports protected Gastown and its position north of Hastings. SQ now reads naturally around Vancouver; district relationship advice also cites the market source.
- City Queen Elizabeth Park page supports quarry gardens and views toward North Shore mountains. These are views, not recommendations in a different municipality.
- Removed the confusing bridge/bus instruction. New guidance asks readers to check the route and final walk, using the tourism neighbourhood page; no unsupported transport geometry or duration.
- Municipal park directions support King Edward/Oakridge–41st on Canada Line and link accessibility mapping. Copy asks readers to check their chosen entrance/amenities; it does not guarantee access.

SQ: less literal overview and market language, proper names retained, concise transport note. Vancouver city remains separate from Vancouver Island.

Travel: public YVR/CA city group and flightable YVR/CXH/YDT verified. XEA rail entry excluded. CXH/YDT are provider identity aliases, not a claim that every international flight uses them. Added generic direct-city infrastructure; no mandatory inter-city transfer or invented costs.

Freshness ownership: GoEksplo editorial maintenance, destination-by-destination human review workflow. Existing periodic reviewBy dates remain 2027-01-10; re-opening a source did not extend them. Stable descriptive content retains stable policy. No paid AI, media research, hotel prices or airfare observations.

Human advisory remains evidence-review, unacknowledged: independently assess these sources, EN/SQ copy, selection and practical wording before any publication. Preparation readiness is not human approval.
